method.event_definition: filer-event = distinct (e, first_avail) pair from the timing observable layer; e = filer CIK ('CIK########'), first_avail = evidenced vintage-availability date (P-1: the timestamps ARE the evidence).
method.event_order: per-event rows emitted in timing-layer insertion order (first occurrence while streaming the hash-verified file); deterministic — two independent full runs produced byte-identical artifacts (same sha256).

window_conventions.STRICT_NEXT_BAR: post-arrival bookable bars = entity EOD bars with date > first_avail (bisect_right on the entity's sorted EOD date array)
window_conventions.SAME_DAY_INCLUSIVE: post-arrival bookable bars = entity EOD bars with date >= first_avail (bisect_left)

method.class_mapping: e -> cohort class from cohort_v9.json members (ALIVE_EVIDENCED / DEAD_EVIDENCED / GAP_COVERAGE / NOT_DEAD_NAME_ALIVE); entities outside every class would be UNMAPPED — zero occurred, nothing guessed
method.chain_group: timing-layer row with depth >= 2 (one row per filer-field-period group); depth histogram taken over ALL timing rows; entities-by-max-depth uses each entity's maximum depth
method.inter_arrival: inter_arrival_days from the revision observable layer (one row per depth>=2 group), percentiles with linear interpolation, per class and pooled; 0 null values encountered
method.dead_leg: DEAD_EVIDENCED entities present in the timing layer: price first/last dates from the entity's EOD file; bars after LAST filer-event under STRICT_NEXT_BAR; death-vs-stale ambiguity bucketed by (last_price_date - last_event) calendar days <= 120 vs > 120 — REPORTED NOT ADJUDICATED
method.placebo_runnability: MANDATORY sham-event placebo control class census. STRICT_NEXT_BAR window semantics: a window of k bars starting at trading index t (k=5 resp. 20) is RUNNABLE iff it fits inside the entity's EOD series (t+k <= n) and NO bar date within it equals any filer-event date of that entity (prefix-sum over an event-date indicator on the trading calendar). Event dates falling on non-trading days can never collide with a window by construction.
method.margin_philosophy: Thresholds are reported as measured distributions, not gates passed. No gate is being adjudicated here: the only verdicts published are per-axis FUNDABLE/BLOCKED, each justified by the stated count. Margin-to-fail discipline (P-2) applies to later gates; this census supplies the denominators those gates will need.

Unresolved at census level; would need an owner-side price fetch if that name ever matters.
UNMAPPED ENTITIES: none. All 2,162 timing-layer entities map to a cohort class; the UNMAPPED bucket exists in the schema and is zero everywhere.
GAP_COVERAGE contributes zero filer-events and zero chains (0 of its 513 members appear in the timing layer) — by construction of the class; reported so the zero is not mistaken for a join failure.

EVENT TRUNCATION AT DEATH: 4,270 priced events (5.70%) have zero strict post-arrival bars; 4,247 zero same-day bars. p5 of the strict_bars distribution is 0. Any later event-book gate must state which threshold it conditions on; this census only measures.

DEATH-VS-STALE AMBIGUITY (reported, not adjudicated): 1,482 of 1,752 DEAD_EVIDENCED timing entities have a price series ending within 120 calendar days after their last filer-event; 270 end later. 1,038 have >=20 strict bars after the last event. Which bucket is 'death' vs 'stale feed' is deliberately not decided here.

PLACEBO SATURATED CALENDARS: 3 DEAD_EVIDENCED entities have zero clear 5-bar windows and 19 have zero clear 20-bar windows — a placebo design that requires a window per event would be unrunnable for those entities unless windows are allowed to sit elsewhere in the calendar (design decision for a later phase, not taken here).

Same-day-inclusive vs strict: the two conventions differ by at most a few hundred events at every threshold (max delta 23 at >=1) because first_avail dates rarely land on trading days of the same entity; near-halt / near-suspension edge cases are inside the 4,270 zero-bar bucket and are not separately resolvable from this census.
Benchmark files were not exercised by this census (event books are per-entity EOD only); SPY/sector benchmarks remain verified-by-pin from the A1 first report.
